summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Provider Connect Wizard on /dashboard/providers. All 10 acceptance criteria from the review request were exercised end-to-end against the live preview backend using super-admin login. Wizard opens, 7-step rail renders, all 4 provider cards present, Next-button gating works, environment/credentials/capabilities/acceptance/test/review steps behave per spec, health check returns healthy for mock (status=up), and the full mock e2e save creates a new provider account (dialog closes, success toast 'Provider account connected', configured grid refreshes and shows the new card). Back navigation preserves selections. Stripe credential inputs render (2 inputs) with Next disabled until filled. demo_upi shows acceptance empty state; mock/stripe show acceptance-na note. No console errors beyond one initial 401 during pre-login bootstrap (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: Providers.jsx save() sends form.payment_methods as 'supported_methods' — verify backend field name matches (it does per code), otherwise fine.
Save button disable condition `disabled={busy || !credsFilled}` is correct for required creds only (empty required list => credsFilled=true via Array.every).
Minor: stripe plugin only exposes sandbox in its supported_environments; if 'live' is required by product, seed the plugin metadata. Not a wizard bug.
Minor: initial 401 console errors before login are expected (auth/me probe) but noisy — could be silenced by handling 401 in api interceptor without console logging.
